summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for quantile scale configuration in D3.js visualization domain. It does not match any existing skills in the registry (which contain Flink DataStream and iterative loop construction skills from a different domain/task_family). Peer candidates are semantically related scale configuration skills but represent different scale types (point, logarithmic, threshold) and should remain separate. Support evidence confirms quantile scale is a valid D3 API capability with no conflicts.
